evidence: PR description: 'Every run prints IWYU suggestions for 14 libmultiprocess files in the non-enforced pass, applies them, and then reverts them with the git restore from #36112.'

result.card: Filters excluded subtree sources out of compile_commands.json before running Include What You Use (IWYU) in CI. Currently, the non-enforced IWYU pass analyzes src/ipc/libmultiprocess/, producing warnings and suggested edits that conflict with upstream libmultiprocess CI and are reverted immediately after each run. Dropping subtree entries from the compilation database prevents wasted analysis and eliminates noisy CI output.
